title: What makes a walkable street?
desc: What turns a sidewalk into a destination? We walk one street in Khon Kaen six times across one week to find out what actually keeps people on foot.

title: Khon Kaen, after the masterplan.
desc: Twelve months after we handed over the Innovation District master plan, what's been built, what's stalled, and what the city decided to do differently.

title: How a city brands itself.
desc: A talk on city branding as a planning discipline, not a marketing exercise — working from a public-realm strategy, not a logo.

title: Reading the Mekong floodplain.
desc: A six-minute field essay on reading the Mekong's seasonal floodplain as a planning document the river has been writing for ten thousand years.
